items.title: Pacers assigned T.J. McConnell (hamstring) and Johnny Furphy (ACL rehab) to the Noblesville Boom.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Pacers assigned T.J. McConnell (hamstring) and Johnny Furphy (ACL rehab) to the Noblesville Boom.

A great use of their G League affiliate team — giving players an opportunity to practice and get work in while the Pacers are out of town or have limited practice time.

items.title: Pacers have assigned TJ McConnell and Johnny Furphy to the Noblesville Boom. The Boom held media day earlier today. Those two players can get some practice time in as they rehab.
